metadata.protocol: outer history season < Y; validation season == Y
metadata.encoder_cutoff: season-wise out-of-fold on history; frozen full-history for the fold
metadata.inference_note: 2024 is a development fold; post-selection intervals are exploratory
metadata.command: experiments\run_v2_rolling.py --stage v5_count_moe_smoke --models catboost_count_moe --features base --validation-seasons 2022 --inner-validation none --outcome-scheme reverse_any --params experiments\params\v3_outcome_seed2026.json --max-history-rows 120000 --max-valid-rows 12000 --bootstrap 20

catboost_count_moe.gate_definition: 2022 fold clustered CI upper bound < 0 AND 2022 fold clustered CI lower bound <= 0
catboost_count_moe.interpretation: Exploratory gate: the 2024 development fold can also be used for configuration selection; final confirmation is leaderboard-only.

recent_denominators.method: LCM of reduced success/middle denominators per 1/3/5-game window

pitcher_target_encoder.implementation: sklearn TargetEncoder cross-fit inside model pipeline
